title: Home renovation budget

agent.name: Nikhil
agent.instructions: Keep a running total in every reply about costs.

topics.ask: Renovating my 2BHK, budget ₹6 lakh: kitchen, two bathrooms, painting. Plan it.
topics.answer: Split: kitchen ₹2.4 lakh, two bathrooms ₹2.2 lakh, painting the whole flat ₹70,000, electrical fixes ₹30,000, buffer ₹40,000. Order of work: plumbing and electrical first, then bathrooms, then kitchen, then painting last so it isn't damaged. Ask Imran for an item-wise quote for each part so you can compare.

That's ₹30,000 over. Options: choose laminate instead of acrylic shutters, keep the existing granite, or take ₹30,000 from the buffer (leaving ₹10,000). Running total if you accept: ₹6,00,000 with a ₹10,000 buffer.

topics.ask: Bathroom tiles cost ₹18,000 more than planned.
topics.answer: Running total: bathrooms ₹2,38,000, kitchen ₹2,70,000, painting ₹70,000, electrical ₹30,000: ₹6,08,000, which is ₹8,000 over the ₹6 lakh budget with no buffer left. Choose a cheaper tile for one bathroom or reduce the painting scope to bring it back.
